linebreak.ph.in: Paste text copied from a PDF or a web page
linebreak.status.idle: Blank lines between paragraphs stay; only lines inside a paragraph get joined.
linebreak.say.done: {before} lines → {after} lines · blank lines between paragraphs are left alone.
linebreak.sample:
This sentence was cut to fit
the screen width. Pasted as is,
it reads awkwardly.

This is the second paragraph. The blank
line between paragraphs must survive.
